Two modest cropped device screens at opposite peripheral edges show only single blank neutral fields; keep them secondary, no glyphs. The three earlier evidence cards may fall entirely outside this close crop. Convey several responders attending to an unanswered question, no blame, hero, villain or implied motive. Same charcoal brush/nib ink, dry-brush abrasion, gray institutional light, handled dirty paper #E7E0D0, muted steel #5E737B, restrained halftone. No moss green, claret, amber, neon, glow, logos, codes, commands, pseudo-writing, captions, balloons or outer border. One continuous image, not multiple panels. controls: Model revision, seed, sampler, strength and billing unavailable.
